title: Search response parser must branch on ResultFormat
answers: Why does team search return empty/garbled hits after changing the search request?
How do I add support for a new ResourceSearchRequest.ResultFormat?
Team search results don't decode correctly with FIELD_VALUES
body: Symptom: a search handler sets ResourceSearchRequest.ResultFormat to a new value but the response parser silently returns empty/wrong hits. Root cause: pkg/services/team/search/search.go:ParseResults used to assume RESOURCE_TABLE rows only. Fix pattern: switch on result.GetResultFormat() and dispatch to a format-specific parser (parseTableResults vs parseFieldValueResults), keeping RESOURCE_TABLE/UNSPECIFIED as the legacy-server fallback. Constraints: any handler that sets ResultFormat (e.g. pkg/registry/apis/iam/team/search.go:DoTeamSearch) must have a matching branch in its parser, and RESOURCE_TABLE support must be kept for compatibility with older servers that don't honor the field.
applies: Any resource search handler/parser pair that sets ResourceSearchRequest.ResultFormat
says: Team search results return empty or garbled after format change
How do I add support for a new search result format type?
Search results display incorrectly when using field value format
Search parser does not handle multiple result format options
Search returns nothing when result format type changes
search: Search response parser must switch on result.GetResultFormat() and dispatch to format-specific parsers, not assume RESOURCE_TABLE rows only. Any handler setting ResourceSearchRequest.ResultFormat to a new value requires a matching branch in its parser (parseTableResults vs parseFieldValueResults). RESOURCE_TABLE support must be retained as a legacy-server fallback for compatibility with older servers that ignore the field. Applies to resource search handler/parser pairs in pkg/services/team/search/search.go:ParseResults and pkg/registry/apis/iam/team/search.go:DoTeamSearch that set ResultFormat and receive empty or incorrect results despite valid data.
